mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_run (run_id, tenant_id, user_id, session_id, request_id, trigger_type, status, model, input_summary, output_summary, error_code, started_at, finished_at, duration_ms) VALUES (#{runId}, #{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{requestId}, #{triggerType}, #{status}, #{model}, #{inputSummary}, #{outputSummary}, #{errorCode}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{durationMs})
mapper.select: SELECT run_id, tenant_id, user_id, session_id, request_id, trigger_type, status, model, input_summary, output_summary, error_code, duration_ms, started_at, finished_at FROM agent_run WHERE run_id = #{runId} LIMIT 1
